name: Argentina
gaps: Jujuy, Formosa, La Rioja, San Juan, and Mendoza: COAs exist but specific contact URLs not readily available. Misiones, Corrientes, Salta, Tucumán, Santa Fe, Santiago del Estero, Entre Ríos: Multiple COAs active but individual club websites difficult to locate; refer to Aves Argentinas coordination email.

Dropped for lack of a presence of their own: eBird Argentina (eBird region page, not a community); COA Guaicurú in Chaco (no presence of its own, shares the national umbrella's URL); COA Ushuaia in Tierra del Fuego (no presence of its own, shares the national umbrella's URL)
Dropped, the social page cited did not exist (soft 404 behind a 200): COA Las Lajas; COA Sierras Chicas; COA Sietecolores Lago Pellegrini; COA Diucón; COA Ñamco

groups.name: Aves Argentinas
groups.blurb: The national bird society and BirdLife partner, coordinating 80 plus local bird club chapters across Argentina.

groups.name: CoaRECS
groups.blurb: Club de Observadores de Aves of Costanera Sur Ecological Reserve, Buenos Aires, with directory of 97 COAs.

groups.name: COA Carancho
groups.blurb: Bird watching club in Palermo neighbourhood, Buenos Aires, running urban birding walks and outings.

groups.name: COA Tucúquere Bariloche
groups.blurb: Regional bird watchers club in Bariloche, promoting observation, education and habitat conservation.

groups.name: COA Tintica
groups.blurb: Bird observers club at Villa La Angostura, Neuquén, organising field walks and species surveys.

groups.name: COA Huet Huet
groups.blurb: Patagonian bird club in Neuquén with regular outings and local birding community activities.

groups.name: COA Ñandú
groups.blurb: Regional bird observers club in San Luis province with walks and environmental education.

groups.name: COA Catamarca
groups.blurb: Regional bird club affiliated with Aves Argentinas, coordinating observation activities in Catamarca.

name: Chile
gaps: Regional nuclei beyond Valparaíso, Metropolitan, and Los Lagos have limited online documentation. Atacama, Coquimbo, Bio Bio, Araucania, and southern regions lack identified club websites or Facebook pages with current activity.

Dropped for lack of a presence of their own: eBird Chile (eBird region page, not a community); Núcleo ROC Valparaíso in Valparaíso (no presence of its own, shares the national umbrella's URL); Núcleo ROC RM in Metropolitan Region (no presence of its own, shares the national umbrella's URL); Núcleo ROC Los Lagos in Los Lagos (no presence of its own, shares the national umbrella's URL)
Dropped, the social page cited did not exist (soft 404 behind a 200): Grupo de Ornitólogos del Maule

groups.name: Red de Observadores de Aves y Vida Silvestre
groups.blurb: The national bird and wildlife observer network and BirdLife partner, coordinating citizen science and conservation across Chile.

groups.name: Unión de Ornitólogos de Chile
groups.blurb: Professional ornithological union promoting bird conservation, publishing the Revista Chilena de Ornitología.

name: Uruguay
gaps: Rural interior departments Salto, Paysandú, Tacuarembó, Florida, Soriano, and others lack documented birding clubs with public presence. Bird watching activity concentrated in Montevideo and coastal departments.
Dropped for lack of a presence of their own: eBird Uruguay (eBird region page, not a community)
Dropped, the social page cited did not exist (soft 404 behind a 200): Club Amigos de las Aves; Birding Uruguay

groups.name: Aves Uruguay
groups.blurb: The national bird society and BirdLife partner, promoting conservation, research and birdwatching.

groups.name: Birdwatching Punta del Este
groups.blurb: Birding community in Punta del Este offering guided walks and environmental education projects.

name: Paraguay
gaps: Eastern region (Itapúa, Canindeyú, Alto Paraná): birding activity present but no independent clubs with documented websites found. Western Chaco: limited community birding presence documented.
Dropped for lack of a presence of their own: eBird Paraguay (eBird region page, not a community)

groups.name: Guyra Paraguay
groups.blurb: The national bird conservation organisation and BirdLife partner, promoting bird tourism and research.

groups.name: Club de Observadores de la Naturaleza
groups.blurb: National nature observers club founded in 2017, offering identification workshops and citizen science.

groups.name: Club de Observadores de la Naturaleza (Asunción)
groups.blurb: Active birding and nature observer club based in Asunción with regular field outings and education.
